entry.title: Plugin Manager App 2.1.0
entry.summary: The Open MPC Plugin Manager as an app: a Plugin Manager tile in MENU, full screen, and the web page on port 8790, without the plugin. MPC OS 3.10.1, Gen2 (MPC Live III, One G2, Key G2, XL). Patches MPC while it loads (a library preloaded into MPC; it checks the exact MPC build first and changes nothing on any other). Install it from the Plugin Manager's add-ins list, which also installs Addin Restore so it comes back after a reboot. Uninstalling and the file list are in `INSTALL.md` inside the z
